findings.trigger: gitCrossCheck is validated only as isRecord; sha-shaped strings inside reachable[], ancestors and commitSubjectsBind are never checked against the 40-hex COMMIT_SHA rule before interpolation into git argv
findings.consequence: A crafted value beginning with '-' could inject a git option (e.g. 'git log -1 --format=%B --output=<path>' file-write). No shell is used (spawnSync argv array), and the registry is committed reviewed data, so exploitability is low; malformed cross-check data currently reaches git instead of failing validation with a named code.
findings.verification: Code read of toEntry (registry.ts lines 228-236); git argv sites at check-source-registry.ts lines 155/164/173-174.
findings.fix: Validate all gitCrossCheck sha fields with the existing COMMIT_SHA regex and add a validator negative test.
